The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:urgent_clinician: An upset or urgent clinician always goes to a human. Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.

Article: Post payments and insurance remittances to accounts
Recording patient payments and electronic remittance advices (ERAs) ensures accurate ledger balances. Only users with the Billing Specialist role can apply or adjust remittance entries.

1. Go to **Billing > Payment Processing**.
2. Select the **Unposted Remittances** tab and choose the desired ERA or paper check batch.
3. Click **Match Invoices** to auto-allocate funds, or manually enter amounts against specific service lines.
4. Review the remaining balance and click **Post & Close** to finalize.

**Limits:** Adjustments cannot exceed the original invoice line balance. Fully closed billing periods will reject new postings.

**Troubleshooting:** If a payment is misapplied to the wrong invoice line, navigate to **Billing > Ledger History**, locate the transaction, and click **Reverse Allocation**. You can then reapply the funds using the steps above.

Ticket:
URGENT HELP NEEDED: Payments applied to wrong accounts while patients waiting!

I am standing here with patients waiting in the hallway and my billing ledger is a complete mess! I tried to post a check remittance from a major insurer for J.D. and somehow it applied half the money to an entirely different family's account, and when I clicked undo it split the rest across four closed invoice lines instead of letting me clear it out. I have no idea what buttons to click anymore and I need someone to call me right this second to help me fix these line items before I can see my next appointment.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hi,

I’m sorry to hear about the trouble you’re experiencing with the payment allocations and the impact it’s having on your patients. A member of our support team is reviewing your case and will be in touch shortly.

In the meantime, you can try the following steps to correct the mis‑applied payments:

1. Navigate to **Billing > Ledger History**.
2. Locate the transaction that was posted incorrectly.
3. Click **Reverse Allocation** to undo the current allocation.
4. Return to **Billing > Payment Processing**, select the appropriate ERA or check batch, and use **Match Invoices** (or manually enter amounts) to re‑apply the funds to the correct invoice lines.
5. After confirming the balances are correct, click **Post & Close** to finalize the posting.

If you encounter any issues while performing these steps, please let us know and we’ll assist you further.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
